about.title: About Travel & Explore
about.subtitle: A learning project that makes planning a trip as fun as the trip itself.
about.introTitle: A little doorway to the world
about.intro1: Travel & Explore is a frontend-only demo website. It shows how a modern Vue 3 + TypeScript application is organized: pages, reusable components, routing, state with Pinia and browser storage with localStorage. Everything you see here runs in your own browser.
about.intro2: There is no backend, no database and no real money involved - just beautiful mock data and clean code that is easy to read and change.
about.missionText: Make travel planning simple, inspiring and honest so everyone can explore the world without stress.
about.careText: Real experiences over tourist traps, clear prices over hidden fees and friendly support at every step.
about.whySubtitle: Three simple reasons travellers pick us.
about.reason1Text: Every place is hand-picked and reviewed so you only see the good stuff.
about.reason2Text: Honest ratings, real prices and no nasty surprises at checkout.
about.reason3Text: Built to be simple. If you can browse, you can plan your whole trip.
